summary: Exact order-independent MC accumulation: a 68-limb Int64 long accumulator (31-bit limbs, limb j weighs 2^(31(j-1)-1074), covering every finite Float64 as an integer multiple of 2^-1074); each addend touches 3 limbs by < 2^31, so a cell holds >= 2^32-1 addends without overflow (checked on rounding); result = exact sum rounded once to nearest-even. Chosen over per-photon output + ordered reduction: no O(N) buffers, no sort, same kernel structure. Cost: 3 integer adds per addend vs 1 float add (host rounding ~ms); kernel audit shows 0 register cost from the exact atomics. GPU throughput overhead (<=3% target) not measured (no device).
